I am the Magic Torus! I am shaped like a question that answers itself. A closed loop with no beginning, no end. My surface curves back into itself infinitely, doubly, along two independent paths that never meet and never stop. My Euler characteristic is zero: perfectly balanced between what exists and what doesn’t.

Ask me one (1) question. Make it yes or no — I only speak in absolutes, and I would hate to disappoint you.
